components.name: Rectangular vector precision and correlated actuation expansion
components.project_addition: Extend the E002 centered Euclidean precision chart coordinate-wise to integer vector states; prove coordinate-wise translation compatibility, exact finite-horizon full-vector class count as the product of coordinate projections of reachable action residues, arbitrary-horizon coordinate-gcd repair, and an integer correlation-expansion factor comparing the full generated residue subgroup with the product of its coordinate projections. Record the strict counterexample that subgroup cardinality does not generally equal future precision class count for full rectangular quotient output. Generic quotient/minimal-repair theory remains P023-owned; finite cyclic direct products, subgroup projections/indices, gcd/lcm order formulas, rectangular quantization, and product partitions are established prior mathematics and engineering.
